purpose: Current executable and gated Phase 2 queue. Superseded Admin OS, Aliyun, AWS canary, and completed historical tasks remain traceable in Git history and indexed records rather than the active Agent queue.

historicalBoundary.rule: Use Git history and docs/archive indexes for completed or superseded tasks; do not re-add them to the current queue without a new Issue and fresh evidence.

tasks.title: Prove the Vercel company-site deployment remains staged after the next real master merge
tasks.goal: Close Issue #457 by proving a real master merge creates a production-target candidate without moving gccwebos.com or www.gccwebos.com, while promotion and rollback remain separate approvals.
forbiddenActions: create an artificial no-op commit only to trigger Vercel
promote or roll back a Vercel deployment without separate exact approval
change domains, DNS, environment values, build settings, source runtime, Portal, Admin, or control-plane services
output credentials, tokens, environment values, customer data, or private runtime material
validation: confirm autoAssignCustomDomains remains false before merge
record the exact staged deployment identity created by the approved real merge
confirm both public aliases remain on the pre-merge known-good deployment
record redacted evidence in Issue #457 before closure

tasks.title: Establish the canonical collector-state contract
tasks.goal: Provide the health-condition matrix and redacted backend/CLI projection that starts Issue #437.
forbiddenActions: change production runtime
add Admin mutation controls
change quota, billing, account, or subscription behavior
output sensitive collector payloads
validation: npm test and focused collector-state tests passed before merge

tasks.title: Preserve safe collector error provenance through current adapters
tasks.goal: Map real redacted adapter facts to canonical missing-stats, runtime, config, auth, mapping, idle, and sidecar conditions instead of collapsing them into a generic exception.
forbiddenActions: change runtime config or restart services
add Admin UI or recovery controls
change quota or traffic-supply behavior
emit raw logs, controller payloads, map contents, credentials, or customer data

tasks.title: Expose canonical collector state through protected read-only Admin surfaces
tasks.goal: Let operators consume the same redacted collector semantics after adapter provenance is reliable, without repair, restart, config, or credential controls.
forbiddenActions: add service restart, repair, runtime apply, or configuration controls
expose public Admin routes
return raw runtime or customer-private data
change production runtime

tasks.title: Define the Portal user and resource lifecycle contract
tasks.goal: Implement Issue #438 as one safe lifecycle read model over existing account, entitlement, delivery, usage, quota, and renewal facts without a first-slice schema migration.
forbiddenActions: treat payment as subscription state
perform a schema migration in the first slice
retire legacy access or change production auth
redesign the Portal broadly
validation: Admin tests and build when frontend consumers change

tasks.title: Harden provider-neutral commercial contracts with all live providers disabled
tasks.goal: Implement Issue #439 with fail-closed payment capabilities, verified fact boundaries, and a redacted event catalog while billing and AppsFlyer remain non-live.
forbiddenActions: activate a payment provider or AppsFlyer
add provider credentials, live webhooks, settlement, or payout
let payment facts directly generate runtime or subscription material
perform a production schema migration
validation: contract, redaction, idempotency, and disabled-mode tests

tasks.title: Extract one measured ownership boundary only when Phase 2 work exposes it
tasks.goal: Implement Issue #440 opportunistically with behavior-preserving tests instead of launching a repository-wide refactor.
forbiddenActions: split services or databases for line-count reasons
introduce microservices, Redis, queues, PostgreSQL, or ClickHouse
hide behavior changes inside a refactor
create a duplicate domain directory tree
validation: Admin tests and build if frontend ownership changes
